annotation.interpretation_b: The default set must contain at least one ALPN, even if it's a minimal or rarely used one.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY be empty" introduces ambiguity. It's unclear whether a valid "default set" can be truly empty, or if it must always contain at least one ALPN. This impacts the implementation of the client's logic for adding the default set.
annotation.missing_information: The document does not define what constitutes a "default set" or whether an empty set is permissible. This affects how clients and servers interpret and implement the addition of the default set to the SVCB ALPN set.
